reviews.title: Read before downloading! Trust me, it’ll save your time.
reviews.text: If you don’t mind ads every 1 minute, this app is for you, otherwise, don’t waste your time. I downloaded this app thinking I could use it to just relax, but no, every minute, there’s an ad interrupting your coloring time, it is so incredibly infuriating that I deleted this app immediately. I didn’t even get to enjoy it much because I had two ads immediately pop up after coloring a phone case on a picture. The color mechanic is smooth, the colors are flexible. But yeah, no, it sucks, don’t let the 4.8 stars fool you.

reviews.title: If u want to pay…
reviews.text:
The game is really good when you have the free trial. There are a lot of options, brushes, colors, canvases, etc. But after the first three days or week or whatever, your trial ends and it asks you to buy a SUBSCRIPTION. The subscription is way overpriced, so obviously I wasn’t going to pay that. But without the subscription/trial, I mean, not trying to be rude, but the game is honestly TERRIBLE. The sign up process is unnecessarily complex, and in the free version, the brushes, colors, and available artworks and features become very limited, and there are way too many AFS every 3 seconds. I also tried the “picture to coloring page” feature, but it turned out badly and I get the feeling that those features are underdeveloped; it just feels like they’re still in beta, and for the low quality images that the ai features give you, there should be way more tokens to get the opportunity to perfect an image. I would also not recommend for younger children, because it gives just slightly a social-media-y vibe, but it is rated 13+, so that’s appropriate as long as you listen to the age rating.

The bottom line is, it’s actually a really good game with the subscription, but the trial ends fast and it’s overpriced, so unless you are willing to pay for a subscription, I would really recommend NOT getting it.

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: This is a good game but there’s several things I don’t like, first of all is the ads. I hate how many ads there are , even for taking too long to click on a button. They have ads for every single brush that aren’t the original brush, and of course, all the different color pallets and it’s so obvious that they just want you to buy their overpriced expensive version that has no ads and they have ads every other time that you touch it. It seems. The second problem is the AI. It’s an app that wants you to be creative. I don’t think that AI is the right option even if this is “creative ai” there’s no such thing as creative AI and if you could get real artists to draw your outlines that would make the game better. The last problem is the little mistakes. In the app, there’s a feature where you can only color in the lines which I think is actually a really cool feature, but since it was drawn by an AI, all the little lines are out of place and they make it so that that feature is kind of useless. on certain areas, it works great, but for example the place where the eyes connect to the face, you usually color the skin and eye whites (sclera) the same color. Another problem I’ve noticed with the ‘people’ section  is that the coloring inside the lines feature doesn’t really apply to the neck. I don’t know why this happens but it’s probably the AI again and as a real artist, I don’t support AI at all and I think that’s the biggest problem. Besides that it’s a pretty good game, but there
